subject: VivantHealth — Eval kickoff & scoring alignment
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Park <epark@vivanthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: VivantHealth — post-demo recap & next steps (eval kickoff)

Emily — great to meet today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps for the VivantHealth model fit evaluation:

What we heard
- Primary use case: automated clinical triage suggestions from patient intake notes (short free-text). Need high precision on "urgent" vs "routine" classifications and concise suggested guidance text.
- Data constraints: PHI-scrubbed extracts provided by your data team; ~10k labeled rows available for evaluation, mix of short/long notes.
- Success criteria: >0.85 macro-F1 on triage class; median generation latency <120ms for 512 tokens; no severe hallucination patterns on safety testset.

Redwood recommended starting stack (to test tradeoffs)
1) Redwood-Chat-7B-v2 (quantized) — best latency/cost baseline for chat-style instruction with controlled decoding.
2) Llama-2-13B (Redwood-optimized, q4_0) — higher-quality classification and few-shot summarization baseline.
3) Mistral-7B-instruct (open) — candidate for aggressive latency/cost experiments.

Attachments and artifacts
- Please upload a 200-row sample (CSV) with columns: id, note_text, triage_label, reference_guidance. We attached a sample schema file (vivant_eval_dataset_sample.csv) and a short requirements summary.
- We shared a Redwood eval runbook link in the follow-up Drive folder for formats and runner instructions.

Scoring & rubric (proposal)
- Classification: macro-F1 for the three triage buckets (urgent, follow-up, routine). Primary metric: macro-F1. Secondary: confusion matrix per class.
- Guidance text quality: ROUGE-L and human pass/fail for safety and hallucination (sample of 200 outputs).
- Latency/cost: median per-token latency, tokens per second—target under 120ms median for 512 tokens for production candidate.

Next steps (proposed)
1) You: upload the 200-row sample and the schema to the Drive folder by EOD Thursday (Aug 6).
2) Redwood: create an eval job template and run initial baseline within 48 hours of sample availability.
3) Sync: 30-min check-in after baseline run to review metrics and pick one model for the full 10k-run.

Action items (owners)
- Emily / Vivant: upload sample CSV + add procurement contact to thread (procurement@vivanthealth.com)
- Laura (Redwood): prepare eval job template & scoring harness
- Aditya (Redwood): prepare recommended prompt sets and safety checks

Thanks — looking forward to the sample. If you'd like, we can flip on a temporary Dedicated slot to avoid noisy multi-tenant variability for the full 10k evaluation.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.inference

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: VivantHealth — post-demo recap & next steps (eval kickoff)

Thanks Sean — solid recap and appreciate the clarity. A couple quick clarifications:
- We'll provide the 200-row sample by Thu EOD; procurement looped in (procurement@vivanthealth.com) but cc'd separately for contracting.
- Our sample will include a de-id token column and a field indicating whether the record is synthetic or real (for transparency). OK to include that column?
- For guidance text scoring: can Redwood run the ROUGE + a small human review panel? We'll budget for ~25 human checks initially.

Also attached: Vivant_eval_dataset_sample.csv (schema + 20 sample rows) and Vivant_requirements_summary.pdf (short doc with privacy notes). We'll upload the full 200-row sample Thu.

Emily

Emily Park
Head of Clinical Informatics
Vivant Health
epark@vivanthealth.com

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VivantHealth — post-demo recap & next steps (eval kickoff)

Perfect — the extra de-id token column is helpful; please include a note mapping for that column in the CSV header.

On the human review: yes, Redwood can run the ROUGE + coordinate a human pass/fail panel for the 200-sample set. We'll size pricing for the human review and include it in the eval cost estimate.

Prompt sets we'll run (initial)
- Classification prompt: 3-shot with positive/negative examples, explicit instruction to output a single token from {urgent, follow-up, routine}.
- Guidance prompt: instruction -> produce concise guidance (1-2 sentences) and a confidence score 0-100.

Security/compliance note
- For the full 10k-run, we recommend running the job on a Redwood Dedicated instance if Vivant requires strict data segregation. We'll include that as an optional line item.

I'll spin up the eval template once you upload the full sample. Tentative sync Friday morning PT after the baseline run.

—
Sean
